newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends little changed in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends little changed in quiet trading.

text.p: The won closed barely changed against the dollar on Thursday as expectations of import deals in the next couple of days kept the local unit steady despite a weaker dollar against the Japanese yen, traders said.
The won finished at 830.20 after opening at 830.00. It moved in a range of 829.60 to 830.30.
"The dollar's decline to the 112 yen level kept the dollar buyers sidelined," one local trader said.
Dealers said the trading remained quiet for most of the day with the won tied to a tight range of 830.00 to 830.20 in the afternoon.
But they said the won may continue its downturn when the dollar/yen stops falling.
"Dollar/yen would heavily influence tomorrow's trading," said another local dealer.
Traders expected a trading range of 829.50 to 831.50 for Friday with a base mid-rate at 830.00. Today's mid-rate was pegged at 830.70.
